research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: frozen/official minister biography, official first speech, MP site, UWA archive and2016 annual report, Perth USAsia employer biography/about page, public professional profile, legal employer/full-time searches. USAsia2017-named annual-report PDF returned403; LinkedIn direct open999; indexed public facts retained. No hours evidence found. Namesake AGS/US/UK lawyers and health academic excluded.

Priority: identify each private legal employer in Australia/England1997–2005 using archived professional CV or 2016 candidate materials (NLA archived campaign lead nla.arc-158282). Resolve admission1997 profile versus official1998 qualification discrepancy without changing employment start.

Obtain UWA appointment/leave/secondment dates and institutional-control evidence. Resolve2012–13 UWA/USAsia overlap and2016 campaign cessation. UWA2016 report establishes only significant influence over Centre, not government control; nonprofit status means no automatic private headline. All substantive hours, breaks and early paid work remain unverified.

Reconcile public-profile volunteer board dates with SRHWA/Fremantle Press annual reports and actual cessation; present label not accepted as proof of current tenure. Further study/early-work sequence requires primary confirmation.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: reopened minister biography and publicly indexed professional profile; added previously omitted UWA Senate, hockey and sports boards, Rockingham consultation and marina reference memberships. Volunteer roles remain excluded; no full-time assumption.

Searches for private firms under King/Morris, full-time work, Centre resignation and Fremantle Press board cessation produced no attributable employer names or employment hours. Several UK/US lawyers, investment analysts, health academics and journalists are namesakes and are not assigned. ABC 2016/2022 election biography describes ten years of commercial law in Perth/Europe, but does not resolve individual employers or distinguish UWA legal work; no ten-year private total inferred.

APH first-speech direct open returned (403) Forbidden; not a terminal job error. Existing first-speech evidence retained. Next avenues: archived 2016 campaign CV (nla.arc-158282), original UWA appointment/secondment files and Fremantle Press historical board reports. No cessation inferred from donor lists or a current absence.
